source_policy: Changes are derived from the existing canonical scenes, not from the parallel VM build_scene.py or map_scene.py implementations.

art_adjustments.flame: Seeded wavy layer profile plus curling side tongues; 48 spiral ember particles, radius 0.012-0.05; coal disc radius 0.5.
art_adjustments.identity: Simplified visual motif only: 2 concentric rings, 6 rays, 3 dots. This is not an implementation of the actual 11-layer identity algorithm.
art_adjustments.avatars: Existing canonical avatar parts copied into seated, standing and 6 degree walking poses. World transforms evaluated after local pose edits.
art_adjustments.cafe: Two-pole Museion sign; A-frame menu; 4 pots; subtle steam; two muted green chairs. VM sign coordinate replaced by actual canonical rear basis to preserve the hero camera.
art_adjustments.animation: Lift frames 1-20, split 21, Bezier flight 21-58 with 4 trailing spheres per branch, phone emission 2.6 at 58 to 5.0 at 67, hold to 72.
